meson.method: python3.12 -m venv .cache/tpt/meson-venv followed by that venv's pip install --no-cache-dir meson==1.4.2 (the release is installed from its PyPI source distribution); the build invokes .cache/tpt/meson-venv/bin/meson directly.

bzip2.method: Download into .cache/tpt/deps, verify SHA-256, extract locally, compile the seven libbz2 C sources with the pinned emcc/emar, and install bzlib.h plus libbz2.a under .cache/tpt/deps/bzip2/prefix.
bzip2.status: superseded; retained only as prior experiment metadata

lua.method: Download into .cache/tpt/deps, verify SHA-256, compile Lua library sources with the pinned emcc/emar, install headers and liblua5.2.a under .cache/tpt/deps/lua/prefix, and expose local lua5.2.pc/lua5.2-c++.pc descriptors.
lua.status: superseded; retained only as prior experiment metadata

fftw.method: Download into .cache/tpt/deps, verify SHA-256, configure with emconfigure and the pinned emsdk, build/install with emmake into .cache/tpt/deps/fftw/prefix, and expose a local fftw3f.pc descriptor.
fftw.status: superseded; failed before compilation and not invoked by Gate A

tpt-libs-prebuilt.method: Cache the ZIP under .cache/tpt/tpt-libs, verify SHA-256, extract its exact top-level directory into vendor/tpt/source/subprojects, and configure upstream Meson with -Dstatic=prebuilt -Dtpt_libs_vtag=v20251019131007. No manual dependency compilation is used by the Gate A build.
tpt-libs-prebuilt.license_metadata: The archive carries per-component license files for FFTW3f, Lua 5.1/5.2, and JsonCpp under licenses/. This metadata is preserved in spikes/tpt/TPT-LIBS-LICENSES.md; GPL compatibility is not inferred or claimed.

integrity.strategy: Verify the checked-out commit with git rev-parse --verify HEAD after every clone/update. For release archives or downloaded tools, record SHA-256 with sha256sum in this directory before use; do not trust mutable branch names.
integrity.source_lock: The TPT and emsdk commit IDs plus the tpt-libs archive SHA-256 are immutable source locks; generated build output is intentionally ignored and is not committed.
